entry_definition: first observed eligible article/conference-paper occurs in entry year e
at least one eligible work in e contains a CN-affiliated authorship for that author
no eligible article/conference-paper attributed to the canonical author in e-3 through e-1
surname passes frozen focal mapping rule for longitudinal surname analyses

distal_confirmatory_endpoint.name: ObservedFiveYearPublicationPersistence
distal_confirmatory_endpoint.definition: 1 if canonical author has at least one eligible article/conference-paper in entry year e+4 or e+5; 0 otherwise
distal_confirmatory_endpoint.interpretation: observed bibliographic persistence, not true academic employment/exit

china_based_author_year.definition: at least one eligible work in year t contains a CN-affiliated authorship for the canonical author

notes: 2014 is earliest entry year because a 3-year clean lookback then lies wholly within the high-coverage 2011–2025 window
2020 is latest entry year because e+5 must be observed by 2025
entry means first observed eligible scholarly publication under the corpus rule, not first academic job
persistence does not imply continuous annual publishing and non-persistence does not prove true career exit
